_comment: Street RBA calls (economists and strategists). Update when an institution changes its view. For each bank: next_meeting = the RBA decision date the call refers to; call = hike | no change | cut; next_change = {month: YYYY-MM, optional label for approximate timing e.g. 'Mid 2027', direction: hike | cut, size_bp, rate_after}; as_of = date of the source; sources = links, newest first (the call bubble on the page links to sources[0], so put the article the current call comes from first). Set call to null if the bank has not published a view for the next meeting.

banks.note: Belinda Allen (Broker News, 4 Nov): 'we think the RBA will remain on edge as we enter 2027, but keep rates on hold', though 'the willingness to hike again is retained'; 'We continue to pencil in two rate cuts in late 2027, in August and November'. CommBank (3 Nov) expects 4.85% to hold in December

Westpac (investingLive, 10 Nov, on its consumer sentiment survey): expects the RBA 'to pause at its December 7-8 meeting to assess the impact of its tightening' and 'does not expect a hike in February either', though 'high inflation will continue to test the bank's resolve'. Westpac Cliff Notes (6 Nov) saw February only as a risk; 4.85% 'likely the peak of the cycle'; cuts seen from August 2027 (Canstar, 3 Nov)

Sally Auld and Taylor Nugent (Broker Daily, 4 Nov): policy is now restrictive and 'All else equal, this set up probably argues for a near-term pause'; 'we are not forecasting further policy tightening from here', though the RBA would respond to an upside inflation surprise; cuts seen from August 2027 (Canstar, 3 Nov)

ANZ (Siddhant Kalra, via investingLive, 12 Nov): hike expectations have cooled as growth slows and 'the case for another hike fades', but with trimmed mean at 3.7% the RBA will stay cautious and not signal a peak; the coming months 'are likely to be about patience rather than action', with a shift to lower rates 'some way off'. ANZ (4 Nov): 'we are not forecasting another increase in rates'; cuts seen from November 2027 (Canstar, 3 Nov)

Shane Oliver (6 Nov): RBA 'will pause in December' after three members voted to hold, though 'the risk of another rate hike remains high'; expects rates on hold 'for an extended period, ahead of eventually being able to start cutting rates but not until late next year'. Month and 25bp cut size assumed

George Tharenou (Reuters, 4 Nov): expects the RBA 'to hold the cash rate at 4.85% for a sustained period until late 2027'; 'the risk of an additional hike has now reduced', and if the RBA does hike again 'the more likely timing remains in Feb-27'. Cut direction and November timing from UBS's earlier view (first cut from November 2027); size assumed 25bp
Goldman's (Andrew Boak's team) November hike call was delivered; no public view on December or the timing of its next change found since the decision

Steve Campbell (3 Nov): no explicit December call; 'Further tightening can't be ruled out, particularly if Middle East hostilities continue', while noting 'The bond market is saying that the RBA may be done'
